    • of

      public static GenerationHandle of(long requestId, CompletableFuture<ChatCompletion> future)
      Creates a handle for a future owned outside InferenceEngine (e.g. serve fallback when no engine is present).
      Parameters:
      requestId - engine-assigned request id.
      future - completion future for the generation.
      Returns:
      new handle wrapping future.

    • future

      public CompletableFuture<ChatCompletion> future()
      Returns the completion future for this generation.
      Returns:
      completion of the generation (exceptionally if aborted or failed).

    • abort

      public void abort()
      Requests cancellation. Queued jobs are dropped (Instant Eviction from the wait queue). Running jobs stop cooperatively between decode steps when the model sees isAborted() (at most one forward after abort).

    • isAborted

      public boolean isAborted()
      Returns whether this handle was aborted.
      Returns:
      true after abort().
